subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After repairing the four stale assertions, should the token-, registry-, CodeQL-, Blacksmith-, and Codex-bearing action upgrades land together or be split into smaller security review units?
rationale: Official immutable release provenance is positive, but replacing executable third-party code across several credentialed and security-sensitive workflow boundaries requires repository-owner acceptance.

options.title: Keep the grouped update
options.body: Repair all assertions and land the group only after exact-head workflow/security checks and security-owner approval.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token, Docker, CodeQL, Blacksmith, and Codex action upgrades into narrower independently reviewed pull requests.

recommendation.title: Keep the grouped update
recommendation.body: Repair all assertions and land the group only after exact-head workflow/security checks and security-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available individual decision-routing signal from the live timeline and sampled workflow history; openclaw/openclaw-secops supplies the required security review.
